title: Not High Quality; Suitable as a Starter Set
text:
Not High Quality; Suitable as a Starter Set. Normally when I think of Cuisinart I think of a better-than-average brand in cookware and appliances, and I have had some good experiences with their products over the years. Of late, though, I have seen a decline in the quality of their offerings, in particular their utensils (their frying pans are still better than average). Unfortunately, this set has some of the same shortcomings I have seen from other Cuisinart utensils of late.

This is a set of 7 tools though I say that begrudgingly. There are 4 actual utensils – a knife, a spatula, a scraper and a fork. Also included are a knife sheath and two squirt bottles for oil and/or sauces.

It looks like a nice set, but it isn’t anything special. The problem is in the quality, or rather the lack of it. The metal is thin and soft, so it is very easy to bend the fork without trying too hard. I spatula is also flexible and I worry that if I try to lift something with any weight the spatula will bend. The knife isn’t high end either, being comparable to a store-brand generic.

The handles aren’t much better. They’re real wood, but they feel cheap and I do not expect them to last.

I wouldn’t call this a bad set. It does what it’s supposed to do and it’s a decent starter set, but I would not recommend it to people who are looking for a set for more advanced/skilled cooks or are looking for a high-quality set for frequent, heavy use.

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart CBW-201 Butter Wheel Stainless Steel
features: EASY TO TAKE ANYWHERE: Great for cookouts and sporting events.
QUICKLY ADD BUTTER: Butter slices of bread for sandwiches, rolls for burgers and buns for hot dogs.
HEATS UP FAST: Place right on the griddle for an easy way to butter any kind of bread.
EASY TO USE: Perforated-roller design is removable for easy cleaning. No Assembly Required.No Assembly Required
description: Quickly butter multiple slices of bread, buns or rolls in seconds! The Cuisinart Stainless Steel butter wheel will be your Sidekick while cooking up burgers & hot dogs in anticipation to celebrate the teams win. Simply place unit on the griddle, allow the butter to melt, then start rolling rolls & buns over the butter wheel! Each will get perfectly coated with butter, speeding up the time it takes to normally toast each bun. Enjoy the ease & fun The Cuisinart Stainless Steel butter wheel will bring to your next griddling event!
